entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara of angel-watched fields, towering castles and leotau-riding knights, where exalted holds sway.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara built on the oozing strata of bygone corpses, a world for necromancy.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara that is a world of gargantuans, with a light-filtered jungle.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane once split into five shards, now one plane in the aftermath of the Conflux.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: The storm of mana that developed at the chaotic center point where all five shards of Alara overlapped.

entities.name: Arkhos
entities.description: A dreamlike plane where night and day intermingle and memories ebb away near Lethe Lake.

entities.name: The meditation plane
entities.description: A surreal, always-changing pocket plane from Scott McGough's novels whose geography mirrors the thoughts of its inhabitants.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient, godlike dragon who once held meetings with advisers on the meditation plane and lost his seat as emperor of Madara.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: The character who battled Nicol Bolas and made him lose his seat as emperor of Madara.

entities.name: Pools of Becoming
entities.description: Pools brimming with magical potential whose fluid power planeswalkers may manipulate.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with an apocalyptic past and many famous regions, too large to be captured by a single plane card.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: A mist-shrouded isle on Dominaria that was home to the Tolarian Academy and now holds a new school, the Academy at Tolaria West.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: The master wizard whose final spell destroyed the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Vesuva
entities.description: A Dominarian island where shifting illusions create murderously envious doubles of visitors.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forested region on Otaria home to ferocious beasts, the Nantuko and centaurs, still recovering from the Mirari's power.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: The barbarian-turned-druid who planted the Mirari in Krosa.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact planted in Krosa whose power caused creatures to grow huge and violent.

entities.name: Llanowar Forest
entities.description: A towering Dominarian forest soaked in life energy and a site of druidic training, home to the Llanowar Elves.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A Dominarian continent, setting of the Odyssey and Onslaught blocks and the Kamahl and the Mirari storyline, home to Cabal City.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A volcanic, dragon-ruled red-mana region of Dominaria that was once the Thran's Mana Rig site.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased Shiv back into Dominaria at the cost of his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: An ancient civilization that used Shiv as the site of the Mana Rig, source of the powerstones.

entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: An unthinkably ancient plane worn down by time, discovered by Urza and reachable through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who discovered Equilor, spent peaceful decades on Moag, and fled to Serra's Realm to escape the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The remote reaches between planes where Equilor and the wandering Shandalar can be encountered.

entities.name: Iquatana
entities.description: A world with an almost pure æther atmosphere where creatures warp and change, home to the Iquati.

entities.name: Iquati
entities.description: Intelligent inhabitants of Iquatana who created the Narcomoeba as living recollections.

entities.name: Ir
entities.description: An obscure plane whose Turri Island is the rocky home of the barbaric Fomori giants.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose blizzard-wracked mountains of Skybreen are home to a primitive barbarian race.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane with the floating Minamo school and the battle-scarred Sokenzan Mountains.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A storybook plane with Goldmeadow, the Great Forest and the changeling cavern of Velis Vel, whose night cycle is Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The creepy night-cycle of Lorwyn, with malicious mischief and the gloomy Raven's Run forest, once Wren's Run.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A plane of constant trade, with Mercadia City on an inverted mountain.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane with the mirror-like Glimmervoid and the Panopticon tower at its hollow center.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Spent centuries monitoring Mirrodin's ecosystem from the Panopticon.

entities.name: Moag
entities.description: A hospitable world with rich soil, where Urza and Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Urza's traveling companion on Moag.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane with a steaming primordial jungle suited to enormous reptilian beasts.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A plane overrun with creatures of foul artifice fused with twisted flesh, divided into nine nested spheres.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: The setting of Arabian Nights, a mass of planes including the Sea of Sand desert.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane whose magma-powered furnace fuels Volrath's Stronghold.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Harnessed the heat and pressure of the furnace beneath his stronghold on Rath.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane where ghosts linger in Agyrem, the Izzet run steam tunnels, and another guild haunts the sunless depths.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of experimenters and magewright-engineers who keep the city's infrastructure functioning.

entities.name: Segovia
entities.description: A miniature plane about a hundredth the scale of a regular plane, with a chariot-race arena.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A refuge plane created by Serra from white mana, tainted by Phyrexians and collapsing under corruption.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The planeswalker who created Serra's Realm and was forced to flee it.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A mana-rich plane that wanders through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: A plane where Baron Sengir rules the Dark Barony from Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire who controls the region of the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Valla
entities.description: A plane over which the Immersturm, a continual storm of war and lightning, rages.

entities.name: Wildfire
entities.description: A flame-drowned plane ruled by the efreet Shah, home to the Emberwilde order of djinns and efreet.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A new, vibrant plane with the continent Murasa, previewed at the end of the tour.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The totality of planes through which planeswalkers pursue one another.

events.summary: Four planeswalkers pursue one another from plane to plane, igniting wild magical effects.
events.quote: The four planeswalkers pursued one another from plane to plane

events.summary: Bant is introduced as angel-watched fields with castles and leotau-riding knights.
events.quote: We kick things off here in the angel-watched fields of Bant

events.summary: The remains of Alara's Maelstrom are explained as the storm of mana at the overlap of the five shards.
events.quote: it's the storm of mana that developed at the chaotic center point where all five shards of Alara overlapped.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas, once Emperor of Madara, held meetings with advisers on the meditation plane.
events.quote: used the pocket plane as a venue for meetings with his advisers.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara.
events.quote: It's been a long, long time since Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara

events.summary: Scholars rebuild a new mage school on Tolaria to heal Dominaria's apocalyptic past after Barrin's final spell destroyed the old Academy.
events.quote: To begin to heal the wounds of Dominaria's apocalyptic past

events.summary: Kamahl plants the Mirari in Krosa, making creatures grow huge and violent.
events.quote: caused creatures to grow even more huge and violent

events.summary: Teferi phases Shiv fully back into Dominaria at the cost of his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Recently phased fully back into Dominaria by Teferi at the cost of his planeswalker spark

events.summary: Urza discovers the ancient plane of Equilor in his fourth millennium of life.
events.quote: when he discovered it in his fourth millennium of life

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha spend a few peaceful decades on Moag.
events.quote: Urza and his traveling companion Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades there

events.summary: Memnarch spends centuries monitoring Mirrodin's ecosystem from the Panopticon.
events.quote: Memnarch spent centuries magically monitoring the ecosystem of the plane from this hidden surveillance tower

events.summary: Volrath harnesses the heat of the furnace beneath his stronghold on Rath.
events.quote: as Volrath himself once did, the power would be great indeed.

events.summary: Serra's Realm becomes tainted with black mana as Phyrexians pursue Urza, and Serra is forced to flee.
events.quote: Urza fled here to escape the marauding Phyrexians

events.summary: Segovia's Leviathan riddle is solved: the plane is a miniature a hundredth the scale of a normal plane.
events.quote: Segovia is a miniature plane, about a hundredth the scale of a regular plane of the Multiverse

events.summary: Baron Sengir controls the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha, ruling from Castle Sengir.
events.quote: the vampire known as Baron Sengir controls a whole region of tightly clustered small villages

events.summary: The efreet Shah rules Wildfire's flame-drowned city-state.
events.quote: the efreet-lord who rules this brass-towered city-state afloat on a sea of lava

events.summary: Zendikar is previewed as the final plane of the tour.
events.quote: At last we come to Zendikar, a vibrant new world to explore.
